metadata.title: Professional Data Standard (Identification)
metadata.description: Standardised data fields for identifying professionals in an individual's life.

entities.name: Professional
entities.description: A professional that provides care or other service to individuals.

fields.name: Identifier
fields.description: Unique identifiers (IDs) associated with the professional.

children.name: value
children.description: A single unique identifier attached to the professional (e.g., NHS number).

children.name: system
children.description: System that the identifier adheres to (e.g., https://fhir.nhs.uk/Id/nhs-number).

children.name: preferredNames
children.description: Any preferred names used by the person.

children.name: use
children.description: How this name instance is used.

fields.name: role
fields.description: Text to describe professional's occupational role, eg. their position in an organogram

fields.name: status
fields.description: Code for the professional's current working status

fields.name: RelatedService
fields.description: References to Service(s) the professional is related to.

children.name: ref
children.description: A reference to a Service record.

fields.name: RelatedOrganisation
fields.description: References to Organisation(s) the professional is related to.

children.name: ref
children.description: A reference to a Organisation record.
